name: MINER ERC-X self-transfer balance duplication
summary: MINER's ERC-X _update cached the sender and recipient balances before writing them, so a transfer to oneself credited the amount out of nothing. Inside a Uniswap V3 swap callback the attacker's contract alternated self-transfers and payments to the pool, settling the swap with MINER it never held; copycats repeated self-transfers and sold.
notes: Self-transfers before the anchor (0x35c84c1e from block 19208453, 0x6d27ce8c, 0xb067b810) inflated small balances that were never sold, so no value left a victim; the anchor is the first that drained the pool.

Loss is the MINER/WETH pool's net WETH outflow in the attacker's eleven txs and the copycat txs of the bundle; the deployer's liquidity withdrawal and ordinary holders selling into the collapse are excluded. The 0.1 WETH seed purchase is not netted.

campaign.selection: Copycats: txs not sent by 0xea75aec1 emitting a MINER Transfer with from == to, plus later txs by the same senders with net WETH outflow from the MINER/WETH pool 0x73227616
